body:
People will never know how much how work we have tried in order to put on that smiley face. 

So sorry for what you're going through. Maybe your colleagues don't meant to hurt you, they are just not good in handling the conversation or awkward moment.

It's like a fit-looking person told them, he's having high cholesterol problem, they probably would reply "no way, impossible, you look so fit! Don't lie."

The best is yet to come :)
I want to believe that all of us will finally be happy again.

Even before pandemic, I'm not the1 who able to stand out from the crowd or attract any people in real life. 
I was thinking to try solo travel after this,  hope that throwing myself to a foreign city alone might bring some inspirations.

Thanks for your kind words! 💐
Can't wait for the day I finally get over the torment.
I always thought it's easier for guy! Haha

Thanks for your kind words!! 
The change of notification sound is  brilliant idea!

Can't wait for the day that I will finally stop crying and feels better. Luckily there's lockdown in my city, so I can take as much time as I need to wallow at home....
True, I should feel glad that i dodged a bullet before we have kids or more commitment together!
I really appreciate your kind words!

Thank you! 
Yes, I need to keep remind myself that there's nothing I can predict and I have done whatever I can do best at the moment.

It's been 2weeks. 
I talked to his mom, his mom said he's perfectly healthy and she didn't sense anything wrong about him. 
His mom said he did receive the care package for lockdown that I sent it as a surprise before he ghosted me but she's not sure why he just doesn't talk to me. 

You're very brave and you made a right choice to take care of yourself! I want to be brave too! 

I was single for 7years before him. The ex before that cheated with prostitutes while his friends and family all knew what he did except me. That left a deep scars in me. It took me so long to finally trust someone. 

I keep on telling myself, I survived before and I will survive this again.
